items.question: Is this just a website package?
items.answer: No. The website is the presentation layer of a broader contractor growth system that can include local search, proof publishing, lead capture, automation, reputation, content and reporting.

items.question: Do all contractor niches get the same setup?
items.answer: No. The common operating layer is standardized, while niche-specific modules, page architecture, proof and lead workflows are configured around the contractor’s market and sales process.

items.question: Does AI invent claims or customer results?
items.answer: No. Pricing, guarantees, reviews, service areas, licenses and customer outcomes must come from verified structured source data.
